get.description: Returns a list of Prime Contracts for a given project.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the company.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the project.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Elements per page

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Specifies which view (which attributes) of the resource is going to be present in the response. The default view returns the full contract attributes. The extended view additionally includes architect name, contractor name, vendor name, and custom field data. The ids_only view (List endpoint only) returns just the contract `id` for each record, for lightweight ID retrieval.

parameters.name: filters[accounting_method]
parameters.description: Filter to unit or amount based contracts

parameters.name: filters[architect_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified Architect ID(s). These are Login Information IDs.

parameters.name: filters[contractor_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified Contractor ID(s). These are Vendor IDs.

parameters.name: filters[created_at]
parameters.description: Filter based on the created_at time.

parameters.name: filters[deleted_at]
parameters.description: Filter based on the deleted_at time.

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified ID(s).

parameters.name: filters[signature_required]
parameters.description: Filter based on whether a signature is required.

parameters.name: filters[status]
parameters.description:
Filter to specific statuses.
For Work Order Contracts: Draft, Out For Bid, Out For Signature, Approved, Complete, Terminated, Void. 
For Purchase Order Contracts: Draft, Processing, Submitted, Partially Received, Received, Approved, Closed.

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description: Filter based on the updated_at time.

parameters.name: filters[vendor_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified Vendor ID(s).

parameters.name: filters[executed]
parameters.description: Filter based on whether a contract is executed.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

items.title: default
items.description: Prime Contract (when the 'default' view is requested)

id.description: Stringified unique identifier for the Prime Contract. Pass as the {prime_contract_id} path parameter to retrieve, update, or delete this contract.

type.description: Contract subtype discriminator. Always `PrimeContract` for this resource.

number.description: The Prime Contract number, unique within the project's numbering sequence for this contract type.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the Prime Contract (e.g. Draft, Approved, Complete).

executed.description: Whether the contract has been executed (fully signed and in effect).

title.description: Human-readable title of the Prime Contract.

description.description: Rich-text (HTML) description of the Prime Contract.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the Prime Contract was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the Prime Contract was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

grand_total.description: An "unformatted" decimal number. Specifically a number with a period as the decimal separator, without a thousands separator, and with an optional sign. It should be assumed that this number includes arbitrary precision and scale, however, the API may not store or process the number with infinite precision and scale.

private.description: When private, a contract is only visible to the creator and the assigned accessors.

base_currency_iso_code.description: Base Currency ISO Code configured from project level; It'll be populated only when multicurrency phase two feature flag is enabled

currency_iso_code.description: Currency ISO Code configured for the financial entity

currency_exchange_rate.description: An "unformatted" decimal number. Specifically a number with a period as the decimal separator, without a thousands separator, and with an optional sign. It should be assumed that this number includes arbitrary precision and scale, however, the API may not store or process the number with infinite precision and scale.

accounting_method.description: Whether contract line items are tracked by `amount` or by `unit` quantity. Default is driven by a project setting.

allow_comments.description: Whether comments are allowed on the Prime Contract.

allow_markups.description: Whether markups are allowed on the Prime Contract.

change_order_level_of_detail.description: Granularity at which change orders attached to this contract are shown on invoices.

enable_ssov.description: Whether the subcontractor schedule of values (SSOV) is enabled for the Prime Contract.

allow_payment_applications.description: Whether invoices (payment applications) are allowed on the Prime Contract.

allow_payments.description: Whether payments are allowed on the Prime Contract.

retainage_percent.description: Default retainage percentage applied to the contract, expressed as a percent (e.g. 5.0 for 5%).

display_materials_retainage.description: Whether materials retainage is displayed on the Prime Contract.

display_work_retainage.description: Whether completed-work retainage is displayed on the Prime Contract.

show_cost_code_on_pdf.description: Whether cost codes are displayed on the Prime Contract PDF export.

actual_completion_date.description: Actual completion date of the work, as an ISO 8601 date.

approval_letter_date.description: Date of the contract approval letter, as an ISO 8601 date.

auto_approve_prefilled_requisitions_on_p.description: Whether prefilled requisitions are auto-approved on payment applications.

contract_date.description: The contract date, as an ISO 8601 date.

contract_estimated_completion_date.description: Estimated completion date, as an ISO 8601 date.

contract_termination_date.description: Date the contract was terminated, as an ISO 8601 date.

contract_start_date.description: Contract start date, as an ISO 8601 date.

delivery_date.description: Delivery date, as an ISO 8601 date.

execution_date.description: Date the contract was executed, as an ISO 8601 date.

issued_on_date.description: Date the contract was issued, as an ISO 8601 date.

letter_of_intent_date.description: Letter of intent date, as an ISO 8601 date.

returned_date.description: Date the signed contract was returned, as an ISO 8601 date.

signed_contract_received_date.description: Date the signed contract was received, as an ISO 8601 date.

substantial_completion_date.description: Substantial completion date, as an ISO 8601 date. Only applicable to Work Order Contracts.

show_line_items_to_non_admins.description: Whether line items are visible to non-admins. Only applicable to private contracts.

post.description: Creates a new Prime Contract for a given project.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the company.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the project.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Specifies which view (which attributes) of the resource is going to be present in the response. The default view returns the full contract attributes. The extended view additionally includes architect name, contractor name, vendor name, and custom field data. The ids_only view (List endpoint only) returns just the contract `id` for each record, for lightweight ID retrieval.

number.description: The Prime Contract number. Defaults to the project numbering sequence for the respective contract type.

vendor_id.description: The ID of the vendor for the contract. The selected invoice contacts must all belong to this vendor. When the vendor is changed, the invoice contacts are reset.

architect_id.description: The ID of the architect for the contract.

contractor_id.description: The ID of the contractor for the contract.

inclusions.description: Only applicable to Work Order Contracts. The inclusions of the Prime Contract.

exclusions.description: Only applicable to Work Order Contracts. The exclusions of the Prime Contract.

accounting_method.description: The accounting method for the contract. Default is driven by a project setting.

allow_comments.description: If true, comments are allowed on the Prime Contract; otherwise comments are not allowed. Default is driven by a project setting.

auto_approve_prefilled_requisitions_on_p.description: If true, prefilled requisitions are auto-approved on payment applications; otherwise prefilled requisitions are not auto-approved. Default is driven by a project setting.

allow_markups.description: If true, markups are allowed on the Prime Contract; otherwise markups are not allowed. Default is driven by a project setting.

change_order_level_of_detail.description: The level of details for showing change orders on invoices attached to this contract.

enable_ssov.description: If true, the subcontractor schedule of values (SSOV) is enabled for the Prime Contract; otherwise the SSOV is not enabled. Default is driven by a project setting.

allow_payment_applications.description: If true, invoices are allowed on the Prime Contract; otherwise invoices are not allowed. Default is driven by a project setting.

allow_payments.description: If true, payments are allowed on the Prime Contract; otherwise payments are not allowed. Default is driven by a project setting.

display_materials_retainage.description: If true, materials retainage is displayed on the Prime Contract; otherwise materials retainage is not displayed. Default is driven by a project setting.

display_work_retainage.description: If true, work retainage is displayed on the Prime Contract; otherwise work retainage is not displayed. Default is driven by a project setting.

show_cost_code_on_pdf.description: If true, cost codes are displayed on the Prime Contract PDF; otherwise cost codes are not displayed. Default is driven by a project setting.

retainage_percent.description: Default retainage percentage applied to the contract, expressed as a percent (e.g. 5.0 for 5%).

accessor_ids.description: Only applicable to private contracts. IDs of users in the project directory (see the Project Users endpoint). These users will be able to view the commitment contract.

private.description: If true, visible to admins and accessors only; otherwise visible to those with access to the Primes tool. Default based on project level setting.

show_line_items_to_non_admins.description: Only applicable to private contracts. If true, line items are visible to non-admins; otherwise visible to admins only.

signature_required.description: If true, a signature is required to execute the contract; otherwise no signature is required.

actual_completion_date.description: Only applicable to Work Order Contracts.

contract_estimated_completion_date.description: Only applicable to Work Order Contracts.

contract_start_date.description: Only applicable to Work Order Contracts.

contract_termination_date.description: The date the contract was terminated.

substantial_completion_date.description: Only applicable to Work Order Contracts.

currency_exchange_rate.description: Exchange Rate from Contract Currency to Project Currency; It'll be accepted only when multicurrency phase two feature flag is enabled and user has the granular permission to edit the contract exchange rate.

currency_iso_code.description: Currency ISO code; It'll be accepted only when multicurrency phase two feature flag is enabled.

custom_field_%{custom_field_definition_i.description:
Value of the custom field. The data type of the value passed in corresponds with the data_type of the Custom Field Definition.
For a lov_entry data_type the value passed in should be the ID of one of the Custom Field Definition's LOV Entries. For a lov_entries data_type the value passed in should be an array of IDs of the Custom Field Definition's LOV Entries.

change_event_attachment_ids.description: List of attachment IDs to attach. These must presently be associated with Change Events.

request_for_quote_attachment_ids.description: List of attachment IDs to attach. These must presently be associated with Request For Quotes (or their Quotes / Responses).

attachment_ids.description: The current attachments to the item. Values should be omitted to remove attachments. New files cannot be attached via this param. If the key is omitted, the existing attachments will remain unchanged.

drawing_revision_ids.description: Drawing Revisions to attach to the response

file_version_ids.description: File Versions to attach to the response

form_ids.description: Forms to attach to the response

image_ids.description: Images to attach to the response

upload_ids.description: Uploads to attach to the response

number.description: The Prime Contract number. Defaults to the project numbering sequence for the respective contract type.

allow_markups.description: If true, markups are allowed on the Prime Contract; otherwise markups are not allowed. Default is driven by a project setting.

allow_payments.description: If true, payments are allowed on the Prime Contract; otherwise payments are not allowed. Default is driven by a project setting.

display_materials_retainage.description: If true, materials retainage is displayed on the Prime Contract; otherwise materials retainage is not displayed. Default is driven by a project setting.

private.description: If true, visible to admins and accessors only; otherwise visible to those with access to the Primes tool. Default based on project level setting.

show_line_items_to_non_admins.description: Whether line items are visible to non-admins. Only applicable to private contracts.

accessor_ids.description: Only applicable to private contracts. IDs of users in the project directory (see the Project Users endpoint). These users will be able to view the prime contract.

signature_required.description: If true, a signature is required to execute the contract; otherwise no signature is required.

id.description: Stringified unique identifier for the Prime Contract. Pass as the {prime_contract_id} path parameter to retrieve, update, or delete this contract.

type.description: Contract subtype discriminator. Always `PrimeContract` for this resource.

number.description: The Prime Contract number, unique within the project's numbering sequence for this contract type.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the Prime Contract (e.g. Draft, Approved, Complete).

executed.description: Whether the contract has been executed (fully signed and in effect).

title.description: Human-readable title of the Prime Contract.

description.description: Rich-text (HTML) description of the Prime Contract.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the Prime Contract was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the Prime Contract was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

grand_total.description: An "unformatted" decimal number. Specifically a number with a period as the decimal separator, without a thousands separator, and with an optional sign. private.description: When private, a contract is only visible to the creator and the assigned accessors.

base_currency_iso_code.description: Base Currency ISO Code configured from project level; It'll be populated only when multicurrency phase two feature flag is enabled

currency_iso_code.description: Currency ISO Code configured for the financial entity

currency_exchange_rate.description: An "unformatted" decimal number. Specifically a number with a period as the decimal separator, without a thousands separator, and with an optional sign. It should be assumed that this number includes arbitrary precision and scale, however, the API may not store or process the number with infinite precision and scale.

accounting_method.description: Whether contract line items are tracked by `amount` or by `unit` quantity. Default is driven by a project setting.

allow_comments.description: Whether comments are allowed on the Prime Contract.

allow_markups.description: Whether markups are allowed on the Prime Contract.

change_order_level_of_detail.description: Granularity at which change orders attached to this contract are shown on invoices.

enable_ssov.description: Whether the subcontractor schedule of values (SSOV) is enabled for the Prime Contract.

allow_payment_applications.description: Whether invoices (payment applications) are allowed on the Prime Contract.

allow_payments.description: Whether payments are allowed on the Prime Contract.

retainage_percent.description: Default retainage percentage applied to the contract, expressed as a percent (e.g. 5.0 for 5%).

display_materials_retainage.description: Whether materials retainage is displayed on the Prime Contract.

display_work_retainage.description: Whether completed-work retainage is displayed on the Prime Contract.

show_cost_code_on_pdf.description: Whether cost codes are displayed on the Prime Contract PDF export.

actual_completion_date.description: Actual completion date of the work, as an ISO 8601 date.

approval_letter_date.description: Date of the contract approval letter, as an ISO 8601 date.

auto_approve_prefilled_requisitions_on_p.description: Whether prefilled requisitions are auto-approved on payment applications.
